CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_course_assignment (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    course_id UUID NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS','PAUSED','COMPLETED','ARCHIVED')),
    assigned_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (assigned_by = 'learning_planner'),
    initial_planning_request_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_course_assignment_started CHECK (started_at IS NULL OR started_at >= assigned_at),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_course_assignment_completed CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= assigned_at),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_course_assignment_archived CHECK (
        (status = 'ARCHIVED' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL) OR
        (status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND archived_at IS NULL)
    ),
    UNIQUE (student_id, course_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_course_assignment_list
    ON student_course_assignment (student_id, assigned_at DESC, id DESC)
    WHERE status <> 'ARCHIVED';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_course_assignment_request (
    idempotency_key UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    planning_request_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_course_assignment(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
